lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows to form a rectilinear grid, with the brightest blobs serving as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow-induced gradient below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs scattered across the first dorsal fin's surface, primarily concentrated towards the anterior base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, prominent, irregular depigmented patch or scar is visible on the posterior portion of the lateral flank near the transition to the caudal peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency spatial distribution of minute, high-luminance spots concentrated on the dorsal-cranial surface.
